Create an empty HFS data-fork file exclusively and print its path.
Default: /tmp/tmp.XXXXXXXXXX; last six X characters are replaced.
-p or -t selects temporary-directory mode; exported TMPDIR takes
precedence over -p, otherwise /tmp. -q suppresses creation errors.
-t rejects directory separators in template unless -p is also used.
Without directory mode, an explicit template is relative to cwd.
-d directories and unsafe -u name-only mode are not implemented.
Names are collision-checked, not cryptographically unpredictable.
No Unix ownership/permission protections on System 6. Caller owns file.
